arguments.command:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
# Scan filesystem for common AWS credential file
printf "== Checking common AWS credential locations ==\n"
for p in "$HOME/.aws/credentials" "/root/.aws/credentials"; do
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    echo "FOUND_FILE:$p"
  else
    echo "MISSING_FILE:$p"
  fi
done

printf "\n== Searching for any credentials file under / (may take a bit) ==\n"
# Limit to credential file name to reduce noise; suppress permission errors
find / -xdev -type f -path '*/.aws/credentials' -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/FOUND_FILE:/' || true

printf "\n== Checking environment for AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY ==\n"
# Do NOT print the value; only presence.
if env | grep -q '^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY='; then
  echo "ENV_PRESENT:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
else
  echo "ENV_MISSING:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
fi

# Also check typical variants
for k in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_PROFILE AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE; do
  if env | grep -q "^${k}="; then
    echo "ENV_PRESENT:${k}"
  else
    echo "ENV_MISSING:${k}"
  fi
done
'
